headline: Sony's Aibo: a robot dog that became family
script: In the 1990s, Sony was convinced a robot takeover was coming soon. The company believed we would all live among countless humanoid robots. Some of those robots would be coworkers, and others would be friends. At least one of them would be a pet. That pet was exactly what Sony aimed for when it created the Aibo. The Aibo was designed to be part of the family. A recent podcast episode went back in time to tell the Aibo's story. The host was joined by two Verge colleagues to discuss the robot dog. They talked about where this remarkable robot dog came from. They also discussed its impressive success and how long it lasted. The group tried to explain why Aibo had such an effect on its owners. They also asked what Sony got right and wrong about robots. Finally, they wondered whether a robo-pet could ever be a global phenomenon.

terms.note: 指外形和动作像人的机器人。
指机器人取代人类工作和生活的设想。
指像宠物一样陪伴人的电子设备。
